versions.content: If a RunnableEntity implementing a server operation is mapped to an OsTask , and the RteServerNumberOfRequestProcessing of the 315 of 1447 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R22-11 related RteEventToTaskMapping is not configured, the RTE shall dequeue all pend- ing requests and process them within a single OsTask execution.

Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00019, SRS_Rte_00049 If a RunnableEntity implementing a server operation is mapped to an OsTask , and the RteServerNumberOfRequestProcessing of the related RteEventTo- TaskMapping is not configured, the RTE shall dequeue all pending requests and process them within a single OsTask execution.
